from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Details extracted from a single document to support case classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The specific title of this document (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    dispute_type: str = Field(description="The nature of the dispute identified (e.g., 'Civil Property', 'Criminal Offense', 'Administrative Review')")
    procedure_type: str = Field(description="The procedural stage or type (e.g., 'Execution', 'Appeal', 'Trial')")
    cited_laws: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific laws mentioned (e.g., 'Civil Code', 'Administrative Litigation Law')")
    parties_nature: list[str] = Field(description="Nature of the parties involved (e.g., 'Private vs Private', 'Individual vs Government', 'Prosecution vs Defendant')")
    classification_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Keywords found that indicate the case type (e.g., '国家赔偿', '执行', '刑事判决')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level schema for one parsed document."""
    document_titles: list[str] = Field(description="The title(s) of the document(s) found")
    case_details: list[CaseDetails] = Field(description="The extracted case details for this document")
